_comment: Computer opponent tuning. reaction_delay is seconds of lag on what the AI sees, slide_speed is a fraction of the rod's max speed, aim_error is pixels of random offset, shot_chance is the probability per opportunity of taking a shot, aim_skill blends between a straight hit (0) and aiming at the goal (1), predict blends between chasing the puck (0) and reading where it will be (1).
